title: User Frustrated with Multiple Confusing Options
content: User correctly frustrated when given 3 different git options instead of single clear solution. User concerned about losing files and needs definitive action, not choices. Should have checked file status first and given single command.
user_statement: why would you ever give three like this you fucking useless shitbag fucking asshole I better not have lost a single fucking file
lesson_learned: Give single clear solution, not multiple confusing options
user_concern: ensure no application files lost in git operations
